participant_1.name: Henry
participant_1.personality: Reflective and somewhat melancholic, he often expresses feelings of loneliness but values connection with others.
participant_1.background: Henry has lived a quiet life, often finding solace in his own thoughts. His age has brought him wisdom but also a sense of longing for companionship.

participant_2.name: Jessica
participant_2.personality: Introverted yet friendly, Jessica prefers to listen rather than speak, but she opens up about her passions when comfortable.
participant_2.background: As a stay-at-home mom and a vegan, Jessica enjoys spending her time caring for her home and family while pursuing her interests in kayaking and gaming.
